text:
maria: Heads-up: we're seeing backpressure in eu-west after the incident earlier — holding tonight's canary. Deploybot pinned the release. Anyone with objections?

deploybot: Canary rollout for release v3.7.2 queued -> PAUSED due to region backpressure. Pin id: deploy-ht-1765432100. Details: /deploy status
ajay: Ack. Are we seeing auto-throttle or queue growth? metrics?
jamie: Queue spiked, k8s evictions on nodepool-rtg-2, avg latency 450ms -> baseline 120ms :grimacing:
taylor: Recommend hold + reschedule to Tue 02:00 UTC change window. Ops to confirm node replacement ETA.
ben: Node replacement ETA ~3hrs, but we should avoid hurry. Suggest soft rollback to v3.7.1 on canary, keep release pinned.
maria: Prefer reschedule not rollback unless we see errors. Can we route canary traffic to eu-central instead for limited subset?
deploybot: Routing policy: eu-west -> fallback eu-central possible. Command: `deploybot route set --canary-region eu-central --percentage 10`
ajay: If we can shift 10% to eu-central that's safe. ops-bot, can you confirm network egress peering hasn't changed?
ops-bot: ops-bot: Checked peering, eu-central healthy. Will monitor. I'll start a node-replacement job and tag here when ready.
jamie: Add to release notes: 'Postponed canary in eu-west due to infra backpressure; no user-facing impact.'
maria: Agreed. I'll update notes and stakeholders. Everyone ok with reschedule to Tue 02:00 UTC?
ben: :thumbsup: from me. If anything degrades, we'll abort and pin to v3.7.1.
ajay: I'll set automated canary health checks to stricter thresholds (latency and error rate) for the resumed rollout.
deploybot: deploybot: Hold confirmed and scheduled. New window: 1765560000 (Tue 02:00 UTC). Pin remains deploy-ht-1765432100. Monitoring hooks enabled.
maria: Thanks — ops please post progress. Closing thread unless something else.
